entities.name: Pyrrolidone-carboxylate peptidase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Staphylococcus aureus proteins A7X782, A6U575, and A5IWB7; length 212 aa.
Belongs to the Peptidase_C15 family, Pfam PF01470, spanning residues 1–199.
Catalyzes removal of an N-terminal 5-oxoproline (pyroglutamyl) residue from peptides or polypeptides; EC 3.4.19.3.
Curated reference annotations indicate cytosolic localization and homotetrameric assembly.
Reference active-site residues are at positions 78, 141, and 165.

entities.name: Proteolysis
observations: Pyrrolidone-carboxylate peptidase is annotated with GO:0006508, proteolysis.
Its specific activity is pyroglutamyl-peptidase activity, GO:0016920.

entities.name: Pyrrolidone-carboxylate peptidase properties
observations: Sequence-derived length is 212 aa, molecular weight approximately 23.2 kDa, theoretical pI 5.23, and predicted net charge at pH 7 approximately -9.7.
